thesis: The homepage lacks a clear value proposition and trust signals, and the site's technical foundation (missing viewport, metadata, security headers) undermines both conversion and trust. The single most valuable conversion mechanism is the primary call-to-action, which is currently generic ('Learn more') and unsupported by any social proof or clarity about the offering, bleeding value from every visit.

findings.title: Missing security headers
findings.summary: All six standard security headers are missing, leaving the site vulnerable to common attacks.
findings.problem: All six standard security headers are missing, leaving the site vulnerable to common attacks.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Add the missing headers at the CDN or web-server layer; HSTS and X-Content-Type-Options are one-line changes.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live origin: missing HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Missing value proposition
findings.summary: The homepage headline is a placeholder, so visitors have no idea what is offered or why it matters.
findings.problem: The homepage headline is a placeholder, so visitors have no idea what is offered or why it matters.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Explicit product/service and key benefit; cta: Descriptive CTA naming the outcome; notes: Add a headline and supporting copy that clearly states the offering and its benefit.
findings.evidence: This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission. Avoid use in operations.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: No trust signals
findings.summary: The homepage lacks reviews, guarantees, or security badges, so first-time visitors have no reason to trust the site.
findings.problem: The homepage lacks reviews, guarantees, or security badges, so first-time visitors have no reason to trust the site.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Explicit product/service and key benefit; cta: Descriptive CTA naming the outcome; notes: Add customer testimonials, trust badges, or a satisfaction guarantee near the primary CTA.
findings.evidence: This domain is for use in documentation examples without needing permission.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: Generic CTA without context
findings.summary: The only call-to-action 'Learn more' gives no indication of what will be learned or what action follows.
findings.problem: The only call-to-action 'Learn more' gives no indication of what will be learned or what action follows.
findings.recommended_change: h1: Explicit product/service and key benefit; cta: Descriptive CTA naming the destination or outcome; notes: Replace generic CTA with a descriptive label.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Weak page metadata
findings.summary: Search and social previews are degraded due to missing or poor metadata, reducing organic traffic.
findings.problem: Search and social previews are degraded due to missing or poor metadata, reducing organic traffic.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Write a 15-60 char title and 70-160 char description per page; add og:title and og:image for link previews.
findings.evidence: Measured on the homepage: title 0 chars (15-60 recommended); description 0 chars (70-160 recommended); og:title missing, og:image missing.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

findings.title: Missing trust signals above the fold
findings.summary: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, reviews, security badge, so a first-time visitor has nothing to offset purchase risk.
findings.problem: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, reviews, security badge, so a first-time visitor has nothing to offset purchase risk.
findings.recommended_change: notes: Surface review counts, the returns window and a guarantee near the primary call to action.
findings.evidence: Measured on the live homepage: no match for returns policy, guarantee, reviews, security badge.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

findings.title: No responsive viewport
findings.summary: Without a viewport meta tag, mobile users see a scaled-down desktop layout, making the site unusable on mobile.
findings.problem: Without a viewport meta tag, mobile users see a scaled-down desktop layout, making the site unusable on mobile.
findings.evidence: Measured on the mobile render: no <meta name="viewport"> present.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

findings.title: No responsive viewport declared
findings.summary: Without a viewport meta tag mobile browsers render the desktop layout scaled down, making every tap target too small.
findings.problem: Without a viewport meta tag mobile browsers render the desktop layout scaled down, making every tap target too small.
findings.evidence: Measured on the mobile render: no <meta name="viewport"> present.
findings.opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

findings.title: Missing trust signals above fold

findings.problem: The homepage shows no returns policy, guarantee, reviews, or security badge, increasing perceived risk.
